summary: Project brain initialized on branch brain-dev
Tencent AI Studio (aistudio.tencent.ai) web cookie provider specs planned: handles hy3-g & Hunyuan models via cookie header auth.

OmniRoute live server (pid 484428) runs from GLOBALLY installed package /usr/local/lib/node_modules/omniroute/dist (v16.2.12), NOT the local source. Local dev server on port 20129 is a separate next-server built from source. Edits to local source do not affect the live global install.

Playwright crash fix: global install had nested playwright/node_modules/playwright-core (v1.62.0) missing browsers.json; top-level playwright-core (v1.61.1) had it. Copied browsers.json into nested dir with sudo cp. Live gemini-web endpoint went from 500 (module missing) to 401 (auth). Unrelated to provider code.

OmniRoute executor API shape (critical): ExecuteInput uses `credentials.apiKey` (no `req`/`connection`). BaseExecutor constructor is `super(providerId, { id, baseUrl })`. buildErrorBody signature is (statusCode, message, upstreamDetails?, classification?). mergeUpstreamExtraHeaders(headers, extra) mutates in place (returns void). Use mergeAbortSignals for timeouts. Return Response directly.

GitHub PR workflow: a personal repo that is a standalone mirror (parent: null) cannot be the head for `gh pr create --repo upstream`. Must `gh repo fork upstream` to get a real fork (here MeRezaRezaei/OmniRoute-1), add it as remote, push branch, then open PR.

Base-red handling: if target base branch is red (upstream issue #9985 for release/v3.8.50), add '⚠️ base-red inherited: #<issue>' to PR body and do NOT try to fix base-red failures inside the feature branch.

Private branch hygiene: to submit a provider upstream while keeping .brain/ private, cherry-pick ONLY provider source+test files into an isolated worktree under .claude/worktrees/, never include .brain/. Verified executor + test must pass before opening PR.
